acceptance: The required jobs fail trunk (or the core unit, for pull_request placement) on a failing impacted canary test, on selector failure, and on missing or inconsistent output, and pass on a recorded zero selection, with workflow tests for each case.
The PR includes the pre-written revert and states the rollback trigger.

A 7-day report after landing gives reddened trunk runs or blocked merges (with causes), trunk-run p50 wall time and release-admission delay against the prior 7 days (or PR p50 time-to-green), and any canary failures the gate missed.
context:
Guardrails:
1. Maintainer approval of this PR is required (trunk.yml, ci.yml and .github/ci-units.yml are soundness paths); no auto-merge.
2. The PR must include a pre-written revert: restoring continue-on-error (trunk) or removing the jobs from the core unit (pull_request).
3. Rollback trigger, fixed now and not tuned later: revert the same day if, in any rolling 7 days after landing, (a) the required job reddens trunk or blocks 3 or more merges whose failures are later shown to be flakes or infrastructure, or (b) trunk-run p50 wall time or release-admission delay rises by more than 15 minutes against the prior 7 days (for pull_request placement: PR p50 time-to-green rises by more than 15 minutes). Revert first, then investigate; do not add exceptions to keep the gate.
4. A canary failure the gate did not catch after landing is a selector bug: open an item for it the same day and link it here.
5. Workflow tests cover: non-empty selection required and failing reddens trunk or blocks; zero selection passes; selector failure fails; missing output fails; whole-suite fallback required.
6. The daily release canary stays as the full backstop; do not reduce it.
